  Striking Degree 3, Striking Degree 4, Tackling This category encompasses
  the use of Martial Arts skills involving the so-called “hard” martial arts,
  typified by devastating blows dealt with the hands, feet, elbows and the
  like. Boxing and such activities are also considered to be Martial Arts,
  and can be found in this category.

@category:               Martial Arts • Sweeps

@classification:         Offensive Bonus
@description:
  Sweeps Degree 3, Sweeps Degree 4, Wrestling This category encompasses the
  use of Martial Arts involving the so-called “soft” martial arts, typified
  by throws, grappling, sweeps and powerful controlling techniques. Blocking
  and Wrestling are considered Martial Arts (albeit limited ones), and can be
  found in this category.

# ===================================================================
# SKILL DESCRIPTIONS
# ===================================================================

@@ Boxing
@stat: St
@description:
  This is the skill of using one’s fists to strike at an opponent’s upper
  body and torso, while protecting oneself from blows. This skill uses the
  Arms Law Martial Arts Strike Table 3.8 and may not exceed the damage done
  by an equivalent Striking Degree 1 attack.

@@ Striking Degree 1
@stat: St
@description:
  This skill represents the basic and most simple forms formal “hard” martial
  art. These forms must be learned before individual may progress to the
  higher degrees, as it represents fundamentals of the art. Criticals should
  be rolled on the Arts Strikes Critical Strike Table 4.5.

@@ Striking Degree 2
@stat: St
@description:
  This skill represents the intermediate forms of a “hard” art. Note that
  this skill is more effective than the Striking 1 skill. Because this skill
  builds on the previous Degree of the ranks of this skill cannot exceed the
  ranks the character Striking Degree 1. Criticals should be rolled on the
  Martial Strikes Critical Strike Table 4.5.

@@ Striking Degree 3
@stat: SD
@description:
  This skill represents the advanced forms of a “hard” martial Note that this
  skill is more effective than the Striking Degree skill. Because this skill
  builds on the previous Degree of the ranks of this skill cannot exceed the
  ranks the character in Striking Degree 2. Criticals should be rolled on the
  Arts Strikes Critical Strike Table 4.5.

@@ Striking Degree 4
@stat: SD
@description:
  This skill represents the most advanced forms of a martial art. Note that
  this skill is more effective than the Striking Degree 3 skill. Because this
  skill builds on the previous of this art, the ranks of this skill cannot
  exceed the ranks character has in Striking Degree 3. Criticals should be
  rolled the Martial Arts Strikes Critical Strike Table 4.5.

@@ Tackling
@stat: Qu
@description:
  This is the skill of diving at a person in order to bring them the ground
  in the intent of momentarily immobilizing Injury is more common than with
  wrestling (although part skill is avoiding injury to oneself during the
  tackle), and in moving situations such as chases, sports activities, etc.
  Arms Law Martial Arts Strikes Attack Table 3.8 is used maximum result equal
  to an equivalent Striking Degree 1 and Grappling Criticals are used. If a
  struggle continues successful tackle, the Wrestling skill should be used
  instead.  Rolemaster Standard Rules 174
